name: Lawrence Hall of Science Youth Volunteers
org: Lawrence Hall of Science, UC Berkeley
what_you_do: You staff exhibits such as the planetarium. Others are Ingenuity Challenges, Outdoor Nature Lab and Animal Discovery Zone. The minimum is 21 summer hours. During the school year, it is 2 shifts a month.
who_can_apply: Entering 9th grade or older and age 14 by June 1 (2024 cycle wording); not a current volunteer. Own transportation to Berkeley.
duration: Summer minimum 21 hours; school year two 3-hour shifts a month
deadline_text: Paused: no new cohort in 2025, with a relaunch planned for 2026 (page text dates from Dec 2024). Last posted window closed Jan 16, 2024. No current cohort confirmed.
how_to_apply: Check the Lawrence Hall of Science teen volunteer page; contact veronicau@berkeley.edu or 510-642-5132.
notes: The volunteer page now says it is not taking new adult volunteers and lists no teen program. Call or email to ask whether the redesigned teen program has launched. The age rules in who_can_apply come from 2024 wording, so the age fields are blank.
